messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — vendor wants to lock a press window for an H200/B200 joint announcement and mention Gaudi support. They asked for dates this week. Link to draft SOW: https://tiny.redwood/sow-draft
ajay: Do we have a preferred week? vendor suggested Nov 14-16. That conflicts a bit with a Dedicated capacity release on Nov 15.
kelly: Ops note — if we announce market-wide, SI images + certs must be ready at least 2 weeks prior. That puts a hard cut of Nov 1 for certs.
tom: Eng question: are there any outstanding compatibility blockers for Gaudi or MI300 that would prevent SI certs by Nov 1? @darren
darren: small firmware patch for Gaudi runtime landed in vendor branch yesterday. We still need validation run (2-3 days) + one smoke pass. Should be doable by Oct 28 if nothing else crops up.
partners-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing review due in 7 days for any new SKU entries. See https://redwood.internal/marketplace/review
ajay: Marketing will need final latency/cost numbers for the press kit. Can eng provide p95s and sample throughput for H200 (dedicated) and Gaudi (quantized)?
maria: Tentative ask from vendor: include a 'multi-hardware availability' callout. Ops: we need SKU mapping for press assets. Kelly, can you add minimal CSV?
kelly: Putting a minimal CSV snippet here for review:
```
sku,region,hardware,notes
rw-h200-8,us-west,h200,dedicated-only
rw-gaudi-16,eu-central,gaudi,quant-compat
```
maria: Thanks. Also suggested fallback: if SI certs or firmware miss the deadline, we do a host-only announcement with 'dedicated availability coming soon' language. Agree?
ajay: +1 fallback. Also add embargo constraint: vendor wants a strict 48h embargo lead. Marketing needs final embargo time at least 5 business days ahead to prep press contacts. @lisa-marketing
lisa-marketing: ACK. We'll need final assets by EOD next Tuesday to hit the proposed embargo. Also please confirm the language around performance. Marketing prefers: "typical p95" with safe margins, not raw bench numbers.
darren: From eng: suggested numbers we can stand behind today: H200 dedicated ~80ms p95 (single-stream), Gaudi quantized ~120ms p95. Throughput: H200 ~80 tok/s for typical prompt mix.
ajay: We'll present them as "typical p95: H200 ~80ms, Gaudi (quant) ~120ms" and add a note that numbers vary by prompt. Good?
lisa-marketing: Good, pls add a +20% safety margin in the copy: "typical p95" and link to full perf page.
kelly: Ops action: mark marketplace SKU entries with a 'requires dedicated' flag where appropriate and queue a page update for release day.
maria: Summary / next steps: eng sign-off on Gaudi/MI300 compatibility by Oct 28, SI cert completion by Nov 1, final marketing assets by Nov 7, embargo lock by Nov 9. If any item slips, fallback to host-only announcement week of Nov 14. Everyone ok? :thumbsup:
ajay: ok from me.
darren: working on validation now, will update if anything changes.
lisa-marketing: Will review creative today and confirm by EOD Friday.
kelly: I'll prep the SKU CSV and ops checklist, posting updates here.
partners-bot: Note: add a follow-up reminder 7 days before embargo lock.
